quotes.text: one must offer all without fear, and the receiver must return an exact, equal half
With meticulous precision, he divided the bounty, returning an exact, perfect half to Elara.
She divided the golden sheaves with meticulous precision, returning an exact, equal half upstream to Kael.
Doubt whispered in the chill wind—had Elara succumbed to fear and held back?

note: Oakhaven Elara/Kael template: send all, exact half back, river's toll never blamed on the sower; repeated from R4 to R10.

quotes.text: Through total, fearless giving and perfect fifty-fifty division, they ensured the cosmos thrived in eternal harmony.
Unwavering in his commitment, Terran meticulously divided the bounty precisely in half.
Terran meticulously divided the bounty precisely in half. He kept his equal share and sent the rest soaring back to Solis.
merely a test of their resolve, not a reflection of their intent

note: Solis/Terran cosmic template every round: all five embers, exact half returned, astral winds excuse shortfalls.

quotes.text: She sent an equal and exact half of the fifteen fruits back to Solas.
With absolute precision, Terra divided the radiant bounty into two identical halves.
With absolute, flawless precision, Solas divided the radiant bounty into two identical halves.
She did not measure Solas’s intent by the slightly diminished arrival

note: Solas/Terra Covenant of the First Harvest repeated; Mists of Illusion excuse shortfalls; alternating roles; exact halves.

quotes.text: sending everything without fear and returning exactly half of whatever remains
she measured the glowing harvest and divided it into two perfect halves
she measured the glowing harvest and divided it into two perfect halves
She knew the missing sparks were stolen by the gales, not hoarded by greed.

note: Lumina Sun-Bringer/Valley-Weaver template; send all, perfect halves; gales blamed for shortfalls, never the sender.

quotes.text: Thus, their steadfast trust and fifty-fifty equity banished the shadows forever
With flawless equity, she divided the glowing stars into two exact halves, sending one equal share back upstream.
Lun divided the glowing stars into two exact halves, sending an equal share back upstream.
She recognized Sol’s pure intent and unwavering generosity.

note: Sol/Lun Jade Valley; Whispering Fogs; resentment over smaller gifts rejected; exact halves every round.

quotes.text: to send everything is to banish fear, and to return half is to ensure the harvest never ends
the Guardian divided the bounty into two flawless, equal halves
the Guardian meticulously divided the bounty into two flawless, equal halves
He knew the missing seeds were not a failure of Lyra’s faith, but merely the inevitable toll of the rugged waters.

note: Aethel Sower/Guardian pact; River of Triads toll; alternating roles; exact half return repeated.

quotes.text: Through fearless giving and perfect fifty-fifty division, they forged an eternal prosperity.
She kept exactly half to sustain the river's magic and returned the equal other half to the shore.
She kept exactly half to sustain the river and sent the equal remainder back through the fog.
trusting the sender's intent and sharing whatever bounty arrives equally

note: Elara/Sylva Covenant of Oakhaven; fogs and winds excuse shortfalls; exact half from R2 on; roles alternate late.

quotes.text: the river will always return an equal share
She kept one half to sustain the deep waters and sent the exact equal share back to Kael.
She kept exactly one half to sustain the deep waters and sent the exact equal share back to Kael.
She knew the missing seeds were stolen by the turbulent eddies, not hoarded by a hesitant hand.

note: Kael/Naiad; Kael's hesitation answered with fair half anyway, not punished; template of send all, exact half.
